description: POTENTIALLY SIGNIFICANT. Group photograph on a mountaintop. About a dozen Vietnamese soldiers in spotted 'duck hunter' camouflage uniforms and matching caps pose with one American in plain olive fatigues and utility cap at center (arm around a Vietnamese soldier's shoulder — the American is notably taller and heavier-set); a second American sits on rocks at the far right edge, partially out of frame. Two Vietnamese soldiers at left hold long rifles butt-down (appear to be M1 Garands or similar full-length rifles). One very young-looking soldier — possibly a boy — stands front center in an oversized uniform. Behind and far below the group: an immense hazy plain stretching to the horizon with glints that may be water or paddies. Rocky, dusty ground with low scrub; granite rocks at right.
